name: KlipperLearn Printer Optimizer
short_description: Free AI-assisted calibration and three evidence-based slicer modes.
long_description: Free, open-source assistance for reviewing original calibration photographs and logs, proposing bounded experiments, and generating Quality, Standard and Speed process/filament presets for OrcaSlicer. No publisher account, paid API, phone or mandatory printer service. Other slicers receive a settings report. The user reviews and supervises physical trials; no automatic printer actuation or guaranteed gains. ChatGPT availability and usage limits still apply.
availability_requested: All eligible locations supported by the publisher and OpenAI; final portal selection requires publisher review
starter_prompts: Review my printer's real calibration photos and logs, keeping layer height and geometry unchanged.
Create Quality, Standard and Speed OrcaSlicer presets from my reviewed trial records.
Help me improve my print quality using these original photos and my current slicer presets.
release_notes: Initial skills-only submission. Includes an offline standard-library helper, original calibration STL, six paired Orca preset outputs, explicit unvalidated trial proposals and provenance safeguards. No printer control, remote API or user registration. Physical and ChatGPT-installed acceptance tests are not claimed.
